title: Menu endpoint returns 500 for an empty category
author: dev-patil
body: GET /menu?category=x returns 500 when the category has no items. Should return an empty list.

title: Canteen screen: play a sound for each new order
author: kabir-s
body: Staff are busy at the counter and will not watch the screen. Add a short sound on new orders.

title: 502 Bad Gateway after every deploy on the campus VM
author: dev-patil
body: After each deploy nginx keeps proxying to the old gunicorn socket. Workaround: restart nginx manually. Seen on 19 Oct, 27 Oct and 8 Nov. The deploy script never reloads nginx.

title: Order token must be unique per day
author: riya-k
body: Tokens repeated after midnight. Fixed by adding the date to the token sequence.

title: Verify the PayNest webhook signature
author: riya-k
body: The webhook handler does not yet verify the signature header. Not done. Needed before we accept real payments.

title: Add nightly database backup
author: dev-patil
body: The campus VM has no automatic backups. No owner assigned.

title: Rate limit the login endpoint
author: kabir-s
body: Anyone can try unlimited OTP attempts.

title: pos-bridge retries forever when the canteen POS is switched off
author: meera-n
body: When the POS is off the bridge keeps retrying and fills the log. Needs a timeout. Riya wrote the bridge.
